meaning: One result page per surface built or grown on 2026-09-25, read at the keyword that surface's largest new page is for. The question each one answers is not how hard the keyword is in the abstract but whether anything reachable ranks on it: a result page where the weakest organic position is held by a domain rating of ninety is closed to a new site whatever its difficulty score says, and one where a domain rating of nine holds position three is open.
caution: Domain rating and url rating are null on every row that is an AI overview link, a sitelink or a People Also Ask entry, because those are not organic positions and Ahrefs does not rate them. Only rows whose type is organic are competitors. Traffic is Ahrefs's estimate for that URL and not for that keyword.

keywords.reading: The most open result page measured anywhere in this programme. A domain rating of 17 holds position 2 and a domain rating of 1 holds position 10, with 48 and 51 in between. Every organic result is a listicle of routes and not one of them says which months are comfortable, which is the gap this page is for.

A domain rating of 9 holds position 3 and the official Tokyo tourism page at 78 is only fourth. The Japanese market's largest Sport keyword is reachable, and the two results above the DR 9 site are a camping magazine and a travel agency blog rather than an authority on the subject.

The hardest result page in this set and the opposite shape to the Sport ones. Six of the eight organic results are government or statutory bodies: the ministry at 91, the rent tribunal at 75, the tenants' union at 72, the money guidance body at 76. The weakest is a housing association at 48. Difficulty reads zero and the page is closed: this is an institutional answer and a new site does not become one. Worth publishing for the comparison it gives the experiment rather than for the position it will reach.

keywords.keyword: how much rent can i afford
keywords.reading: Eighteen thousand a month and the top three are Zillow, calculator.net and apartments.com, which is what a portal SERP looks like. The reachable slot is position 6, held by a credit union at domain rating 34 with six thousand visits, and every page above it is a calculator rather than an article. That is the shape to build to: the tool, not the explainer.

The best combination in the Tools surface: a thousand a month, difficulty zero, and the incumbents are a domain rating of 48 at position 2 followed by 22, 18, 57, 34 and 20. Position 6 is a quiz, which is exactly the page shape this tool takes, and it is held by a domain rating of 18.

The Spanish region pages behave like the German ones measured yesterday. A union site at 74 and a newspaper calendar at 77 hold the top, the regional government's own PDF is fifth, and position 9 is a payroll blog at domain rating 12. Three of the ten results are a PDF, an Instagram post and a Facebook post, which is the state of the incumbent answer.

Measured for a surface that has no page, because the size of what is blocked is worth recording precisely. Two thousand two hundred a month at difficulty 1, and the result page is Reddit, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube with a tour operator at domain rating 39 in fourth and a personal blog at domain rating 1 in tenth. There is no authority on this question at all. The reason there is no page is that every host publishing comparable crime data answers 403 to CONNECT at this environment's egress proxy.
